verdict.rationale: Netlify documents an official Netlify SDK for building extensions and integrations, and its docs show a `getStore("file-uploads")` storage API inside project code, so first-party SDKs exist. Programmatic platform access is otherwise via the REST API, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. missing for 10: documented official client SDKs for the REST API (language coverage, package names), a published OpenAPI spec for SDK generation, depth beyond one-line descriptions, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
